consent.title: Authorize OpenFlare access
consent.description: {client} requests access to this OpenFlare instance. Select the permission groups to grant.
consent.review: Review the client and its requested permissions.
consent.adminRequired: An OpenFlare administrator account is required to authorize this connection.
consent.invalidRequest: This authorization request is invalid or has expired. Start a new connection from the client.

scopes.security:read: View WAF flows, attack protection groups, IP groups, and PoW policies
scopes.security:write: Manage site WAF, PoW, authentication, and attack protection groups
scopes.sites:write: Create and modify sites and domains

settings.connectionDescription: Add a remote MCP connection using Streamable HTTP. The first connection requires browser consent.
settings.instructions: Add a remote MCP connection named {name} using Streamable HTTP at {url} with OAuth authentication. After granting access in the browser, call openflare_connection_info to confirm instance ID {instance} and the permissions granted.
settings.tokenDescription: Connect with an existing personal access token. Built-in MCP accepts only tokens with administrator privileges enabled; that token can call all MCP tools. OAuth allows read and write permissions to be granted separately.
settings.instructionsAccessToken: Add a Streamable HTTP connection at {url}. Set Authorization: Bearer TOKEN in the custom request headers. Create a token with administrator privileges enabled on the Personal Access Tokens page, where you can also manage, rotate, or revoke it. The token can call all MCP tools.
settings.revokeDescription: Revoking access immediately invalidates this account's OAuth grants for CLI and MCP clients. Manage personal access tokens separately on the Personal Access Tokens page.
settings.copyError: Could not copy. Copy the value manually.
settings.sessionSecretTooShort: Automation requires a session secret of at least 32 bytes. The migration command checks whether stored credentials need to be re-encrypted.
settings.rotationGuide: View the session secret rotation guide
settings.disabled: Save an address reachable by clients to enable MCP connections.
